description: Receive authenticated events and post to configured webhook routes
author: Serg Parf

post.help: Post one body once to a configured outbound route; return status and text

args.name: route
args.help: Configured outbound route name; a caller cannot supply a URL

args.name: body
args.help: UTF-8 body, unchanged; at most 262144 bytes and the route cap

routes.help: List configured route names and directions without credentials or URLs
